public.title: Combination Sum IV
public.description: Return the number of ordered sequences of elements from values whose sum is target. Reuse is allowed and order matters. Values are distinct positive integers from 1 to 100; there are 0 to 20 values. target is 0 to 30. The empty sequence is the single way to make zero.
hints: Choose the final element of each ordered sequence.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: For each total, sum the counts for totals obtained by removing one possible last value. O(target times values) time and O(target) space.
